channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mark Williams | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mark Williams from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Bronny James, Jaden Hardy, Mark Williams, Dalton Knecht
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Dalton Knecht is not expected to make the Lakers' regular season roster. Lakers have 16 guaranteed contracts and going into the season you can only have 15 guaranteed contracts. Apparently, Bronny James and Jaden Hardy have been outplaying him in campand he's viewed as the odd man out. And it's crazy because Dalton Knecht seemed to like he had a little bit of promise to him, but after that trade that got voided by the Hornets to bring him in and send Mark Williams to the Lakers, the Lakers voided the trade because of Mark Williams' back. Dalton Knecht just been in purgatory ever since and ultimately I think it ruined him.”

Draymond Green on Bronny James, Jaden Hardy, Mark Williams, Dalton Knecht, Oct 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Royce O'Neale on Grayson Allen, Jordan Goodwin, Mark Williams
item.description:
Royce O'Neale on Suns injuries as Mark Williams (foot), Grayson Allen (hamstring) and Jordan Goodwin (cal) are listed as questionable for tonight's Game 2 at OKC:

“It's basketball. Injuries happen. You don't want them to, but I think it's just how we bounce back from them. Guys working their way back. Doing all the extra work behind the scenes to come back. Staying healthy is a big part of it. Those guys taking pride coming back. Being able to want to play and then try to get to full strength.”

Royce O'Neale on Grayson Allen, Jordan Goodwin, Mark Williams, Apr 22, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordan Ott on Mark Williams
item.description:
Suns coach Jordan Ott on Mark Williams (right knee injury management) being available tonight in second of a back-to-back vs. 76ers:

“Looks like he's going to be headed that way. Came out of the back-to-back pretty good.29 minutes (vs. Nets). He wants to play. He wants to play these back-to-backs. Done all the work in the lead up. Hopefully it ends up in a good space.”

Jordan Ott on Mark Williams, Jan 20, 2026. Source: x.com.
